The arguments of the `Logger` constructor.

## Signature

```typescript
export type LoggerArguments<C extends LoggerConsole = Console> = Console extends C ? [params?: LoggerParams<C>] : [params: LoggerParams<C> & {
    console: C;
}];
```
**References:** [LoggerConsole](/logger-ts/docs/api/logger/typealiases/loggerconsole)<!-- -->, [LoggerParams](/logger-ts/docs/api/logger/interfaces/loggerparams)

## Remarks

The options are optional, and so is the console, if the JavaScript standard `console` object is of type `C`<!-- -->; otherwise the console is required, since the logger would use an object that is not of the type that the `console` accessor promises.
